title: Solo Mining vs Pool Mining: What Are the Odds?
hook: Solo mining or a pool: what are your odds?

scenes.narration: A solo miner keeps the whole reward, but with high variance.
One source puts a one terahash desk miner at roughly seventeen thousand years on average per block.
Pool miners get smaller, more frequent payments, with lower variance.

cta: Solo or pool for you? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: Solo means big but rare rewards. Pools trade that for smaller, steadier ones.
